scope: Model token pricing, per 1M tokens, USD. Ground-truth DATA registry: conformance vectors validate verdict semantics (priced / contract-difference / UNPROVABLE), never these tables — see CONTRIBUTING 'Where does a pricing contribution go'.

entry_rules.time_windowed: a model may price flat, or via windows[]; exactly one window must carry fallback:true (applies whenever no explicit window matches — e.g. off-peak as the complement of published peak hours); a window with explicit hours must carry hours_utc as HH:MM-HH:MM ranges
entry_rules.numbers_must_be: copied from the vendor's official pricing page on verified_on — never ratio-generated, never from memory
